goal: Finish Vulkan-side cleanup in this stage. M2 exits only when Vulkan no longer keeps duplicated progression ownership or ingress-side policy leaks.
entry_gate: testscripts/test_rhi_translate.ps1 passed on the current baseline.
testscripts/test_all.ps1 passed on the current baseline.

hard_rules.rule: Do not move speculative code to RHI in M2. M2 is Vulkan cleanup first.
Do not keep duplicated SubmitGPU progression across RHIExecutor and Vulkan ingress after M2.
Do not keep present-only fallback waits in RHI admission code after M2.
Do not keep ingress-owned late-stage policy after M2. Ingress is orchestration-only.
End Vulkan cleanup in M2 unless a hard blocker is found and documented in the milestone plus active checkpoint together.

checkpoints.title: Instance-backed backend executor ingress
checkpoints.rule: Replace the long-term switch-plus-static ingress shape with instance-backed executor ownership.
actions: Reduce ERHIType branching to backend creation only.
Route Enqueue, Flush, Sync, and ShutDown through the backend executor instance.
Delete long-term dependence on Vulkan static ingress entrypoints as public architecture.
exit_gate: RHIExecutor is an owner, not a policy switchboard.
Vulkan ingress participates through the shared executor contract.

checkpoints.title: Collapse duplicated Flush and Sync progression
checkpoints.rule: SubmitGPU progression and Sync boundary materialization must each have one owner.
actions: Remove duplicated SubmitGPU progression between RHIExecutor::Sync and Vulkan ingress sync flow.
Make Flush depth handling explicit at the backend executor boundary.
Make Sync return one ordered boundary after the required progression depth only once.
exit_gate: No target code path performs implicit SubmitGPU progression twice.
Sync behavior is readable without backend-side semantic duplication.

checkpoints.title: Move present ordering out of RHI admission
checkpoints.rule: Present-only ordering belongs to Vulkan runtime progression, not RHI admission fallback logic.
actions: Delete pre-enqueue present sync waits from RHI admission code.
Keep ordered present handling inside Vulkan submission runtime or equivalent late-stage owner.
Preserve present correctness without reopening ingress-side policy leaks.
exit_gate: RHIExecutor admission no longer waits Present just to admit work.
Present ordering remains backend-correct and stage-owned.

checkpoints.title: Thin Vulkan ingress to orchestration-only
checkpoints.rule: Vulkan ingress owns batch admission, pipe orchestration, flush dispatch, and lifetime only.
actions: Keep preprocess, translate, submission, and interrupt ownership local to their stages.
Remove ingress-owned late-stage policy and duplicated control logic.
Keep stage dependencies forward-only and explicit.
exit_gate: Vulkan ingress reads as orchestration code.
Stage-local behavior is no longer hidden behind ingress-side helpers.

checkpoints.title: Close Vulkan cleanup in M2
checkpoints.rule: M2 does not leave residual Vulkan cleanup debt that belongs to the same ownership problem class.
actions: Delete remaining duplicated progression ownership in Vulkan executor flow.
Delete remaining ingress-side fallback policy tied to present or sync ordering.
Document only post-cleanup shared-lift work for M3.
exit_gate: Vulkan cleanup is closed for executor ownership, progression semantics, and stage boundaries.
M3 starts with shared-lift work, not unfinished Vulkan cleanup.

checkpoints.title: Validation and document lockstep
checkpoints.rule: Each cleanup landing is validated and each replan updates milestone plus active checkpoint together.
actions: Run testscripts/test_rhi_translate.ps1 after each progression or stage-boundary landing.
Run testscripts/test_all.ps1 after each milestone-sized landing.
Update docs/milestones/rhi/refactor_milestone.json together with this file on every replan.
exit_gate: Validation is green at focused and aggregate level.
No checkpoint drift exists between the milestone and M2 file.

stage_exit_gate: Flush and Sync semantics no longer keep duplicated ownership in Vulkan cleanup scope.
Present ordering no longer depends on RHI admission fallback waits.
M3 can start with shared-lift work instead of unfinished Vulkan cleanup.
validation: Start from the passed baseline recorded in M1 and the milestone file.
Run testscripts/test_rhi_translate.ps1 first on each landing.
